title: इतर कविता मा जनजातीय संस्कृति
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा पराजित पोमुद्वारा सम्पादित ‘इतर कविता’ कृतिमा समाविष्ट कवितालाई पाठका रूपमा लिई त्यसमा प्रयुक्त जनजातीय संस्कृतिका विभिन्न पक्षहरूको विश्लेषण र मूल्याङ्कन गरेर उक्त कविताका वैचारिकताको निरूपण गरिएको छ । ‘इतर कविता’ कृतिभित्र समावेश भएका नेपाली साहित्यका जनजाति समुदायका तीनसयभन्दा बढी समकालीन कविहरूका कविताहरूमध्ये जनजातीय संस्कृतिसँग सम्बद्ध कविताहरूको चयन गरी ती कवितामा अभिव्यक्त जनजातीय संस्कृतिका विविध पक्षहरूको विश्लेषण र मूल्याङ्कन गर्नु यस लेखको उद्देश्य हो । यसमा चयनित कविता–विश्लेषणका लागि जनजातीय संस्कृतिका आधारभूत मान्यताहरूलाई सैद्धान्तिक ढाँचाका रूपमा अवलम्बन गरी सोद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट पद्धतिबाट पाठगत तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । त्यसका निम्ति जनजातीय संस्कृतिअन्तर्गत परम्परागत संस्कृति, निर्मित संस्कृति र आयातीत तथा मिश्रित संस्कृति आदि सन्दर्भलाई सैद्धान्तिक तथा आवश्यकताअनुसार अवधारणात्मक ढाँचाका रूपमा उपयोग गरी अध्ययन सम्पन्न गरिएको छ र ‘इतर कविता’ कृतिका कवितामा जनजातीय संस्कृतिसँगै मिसिएर जनजातीय पहिचान र अस्तित्वका पक्ष पनि समानान्तर रूपमा आएको र जनजातीय संस्कृतिको प्रयोग र जनजातीय पहिचान नै ‘इतर कविता’ को मूल विषय भएको र पहिचानको खोजी नै यस कृतिभित्रका कविताको मूल उद्देश्य हो भन्ने निष्कर्ष यसमा निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, the poems included in the work 'Itar Kavita', edited by Parajit Pomu, are taken as texts, and the various aspects of the ethnic culture used in them are analyzed and evaluated, thereby determining the ideational content of those poems. Among the poems of more than three hundred contemporary poets from Nepal's ethnic communities included in the work 'Itar Kavita', selecting those poems associated with ethnic culture and analyzing and evaluating the various aspects of ethnic culture expressed in them is the objective of this article. For this, for the analysis of the selected poems, the basic tenets of ethnic culture were adopted as a theoretical framework, and textual data were collected through purposive sampling. For that purpose, contexts such as traditional culture, constructed culture, and imported and mixed culture under ethnic culture were used as theoretical and need-based conceptual frameworks, and the study was completed, and it has been concluded in this that in the poems of 'Itar Kavita', ethnic identity and existence also emerged in parallel, mixed with ethnic culture, and that the use of ethnic culture and ethnic identity is the main subject of 'Itar Kavita', and that the search for identity is the main objective of the poems in this work.

informal_english: In this article, I look at the poems in Parajit Pomu's edited collection 'Itar Kavita' as texts, and break down and judge the different sides of the ethnic culture used in them to work out what those poems are really about. Out of the more than three hundred contemporary poets from Nepal's ethnic communities whose poems appear in 'Itar Kavita', picking the ones tied to ethnic culture and breaking down and judging the different sides of ethnic culture expressed in them is what this article sets out to do. For that, I took the basic ideas of ethnic culture as a theory framework and gathered text data through purposive sampling. For that, things like traditional culture, made-up culture, and imported and mixed culture under ethnic culture were used as theory and need-based frameworks, and the study was finished, and the conclusion reached here is that in the poems of 'Itar Kavita', ethnic identity and existence also show up side by side, mixed in with ethnic culture, and that the use of ethnic culture and ethnic identity is the main subject of 'Itar Kavita', and that the search for identity is the main aim of the poems in this work.
